eyebrow.zh: 4 套归一 · 1 条命令 · agent 直读飞书/钉钉/企微
eyebrow.en: 4 suites in one · 1 command · agent reads Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom

headline.zh:
一次登录
agent 读懂你的飞书/钉钉/企微
headline.en:
One login
your agent reads your Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom

sub.zh: 一次浏览器授权把凭证存好，飞书文档正文、钉钉日历、企微消息以 JSON 直接落进你的 agent 上下文——3 套已通，腾讯文档用同一种方式，下一版就位。
sub.en: One browser auth caches your token; your Feishu docs, DingTalk calendar and WeCom messages land in your agent's context as JSON it can read. 3 suites live; Tencent Docs arrives the same way next release.

title.en: Log in once, remembered across sessions

body.zh: 登录一次就够了。凭证存在你本机，下次开机、换个会话都还在——不用反复授权，更不用为每个套件手搓一遍登录。飞书/钉钉/企微已通，腾讯文档走同一种方式，下一版就位。
body.en: Log in once and you're done. The token lives on your machine and survives restarts and new sessions — no re-authenticating, and no hand-built login per suite. Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom are live; Tencent Docs arrives the same way next release.

title.zh: agent 直接读懂你的飞书文档
title.en: Your agent reads your Feishu docs

body.zh: 一条命令把飞书文档正文拉出来，变成你的 agent 能直接读的 JSON 落进上下文。不用复制粘贴，也不用自己封一个文档接口。
body.en: One command pulls your Feishu doc body and drops it into your agent's context as JSON it can read. No copy-paste, no hand-rolling a doc API.

title.zh: 4 套办公套件，一种命令写法
title.en: Four office suites, one command grammar

body.zh: 飞书、钉钉、企微、腾讯文档——四家各自一套接口和登录。suiter 的设计是让四家共用同一种命令写法：登录、读取、写入都一样。飞书/钉钉/企微已通，腾讯文档复用同一套登录与缓存，下一版接入。
body.en: Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Tencent Docs — four suites, each with its own API and login. suiter is designed so all four share one command shape: login, read and write work the same way. Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom are live; Tencent Docs reuses the same login and cache, arriving next release.

title.zh: 接的是你真正在用的那四家
title.en: It talks to the four you actually use

body.zh: 能让 agent 读写 Google Workspace 的工具不少，可 CN 开发者真正活在飞书、钉钉、企微、腾讯文档里——那些数据外面的工具够不到。suiter 为这四家而生，飞书/钉钉/企微已通、腾讯文档在路上，全程在本机跑、不连云，你的 agent 在你自己的办公数据上干活。
body.en: Plenty of tools let an agent read Google Workspace — but CN devs actually live in Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and Tencent Docs, and that data is out of reach for outside tools. suiter is built for those four — Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom live, Tencent Docs on the way — runs entirely on your machine with no cloud, and lets your agent work on your own office data.

headline.zh: 把 4 套手搓登录，收成一条命令
headline.en: Collapse 4 hand-built logins into one command

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。让 agent 读懂你自己的办公数据，这一核心动作永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. Letting your agent read your own office data is never gated.

tag.zh: 给 coding agent 接上飞书/钉钉/企微/腾讯文档的命令行工具
tag.en: The CLI that connects coding agents to Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Tencent Docs
